notes.title: Another major demo update!
notes.content:
[b]Dear followers,[/b]

We've been working tirelessly to bring you this exciting major demo update! We've finalized the game's progress and unlock mechanics, polished the related screens, and—most importantly—[b]enhanced the roguelite gameplay experience.[/b]

Check out all the updates we've made, and don't forget to follow us [u]and add the game to your wishlist![/u]

Thank you for your support, Peter & Tomas

notes.title: Major Demo Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello, amazing followers![/b]

First and foremost, we want to express our heartfelt gratitude for your support! The journey of game development can be full of ups and downs, but your enthusiasm keeps us motivated. Today, we’re thrilled to share some exciting news—we’re rolling out a major update to our demo!

Here’s what you can expect in this revamped demo:

[b]Enhanced rogue-lite mechanics for deeper, more engaging gameplay.

Four brand-new cars for you to master and conquer.

Two fresh maps to explore: the scorching desert and the bustling streets of Brooklyn.

Two exciting new modes: In addition to Escort Mode, dive into the chaos of Derby Mode or test your survival skills in Survivor Mode.

Visual overhaul: We've introduced cel-shading to give the game a stunning new look—think Borderlands-style!

Polished maps and environments for a smoother and more immersive experience.

Improved gameplay mechanics for refined and dynamic action.

Pickups added: Now enjoy collectible pickups to spice up your matches!

Realistic car destruction: Experience detailed physics-based car destruction for thrilling visuals and gameplay.

And much, much more![/b]

We know it’s been a while since you last heard from us—trust us, we’ve been hard at work to bring this update to life. Thank you for your patience, your support, and those all-important wishlists.

Stay tuned for more exciting updates, and let us know what you think about the new demo.

Warm regards, Tomas
